mapper.sql: file_id, biz_type, biz_id, original_name, stored_name, path, size, content_type, uploader_id, upload_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_attachment (biz_type, biz_id, original_name, stored_name, path, size, content_type, uploader_id) VALUES (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{path}, #{size}, #{contentType}, #{uploaderId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_attachment WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} ORDER BY file_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_attachment SET biz_id = #{bizId} WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
